Telford Town v Sandbach United

Foley crosses, Birchall taps it home but it’s ruled offside….

The Bach forcing the game early doors

0 0

🔵⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Telford Town v Sandbach United

Get in, Foley in space wide left and he puts a cross in that the keeper mis-judged and it’s in the net at the far post and The Bach take an early lead.

Straight from the kick off Hall makes a great save to keep the lead.

0 1

Telford Town v Sandbach United

And it’s 2!!!!!!! As Robbie Hatton steals possession in the middle of the park, drives forward, slips in Foley who beats his man inside out and slots it in past the despairing keeper in the Telford goal

@TelfordTownFC 

0 2

13 mins

Telford Town v Sandbach United

And it’s 3 as Cope delivers a peach of a free kick and Kieran O’Connell absolutely smacks it in the back of the net from 10yards out, what a finish, a real screamer!!!!

0 3

30 mins
